The server has many providers configured; this VK allows only openai+anthropic, and both list-models endpoints must return only those providers and exclude the rest (mistral, gemini, groq).

item.name: Governance - VK Model Patterns
item.description: Pattern twins of the model lists (allowed_models_patterns and blacklisted_models_patterns on a VK provider config, models_patterns and blacklisted_models_patterns on a provider key): raw RE2 patterns matched case-insensitively as a full match against the model name and provider/model, next to the exact lists which stay exact. Sections: write-time validation (400s on VK and provider-key endpoints, including the wildcard and a regex-looking exact name that is accepted as a plain name), a base VK exercised on both list-models endpoints plus a real completion and two refusals, a permutation matrix of allow/block combinations checked against the catalog listing and refusal probes, VK updates flipping the listing, and a provider-key round-trip.
